title: How to download DATA from AAPS or NightScout
body:
HI, 
I can not find any way to download my personal data from NightScout. I would like to download all information (bg, basals, notes, bolus..) to use another source for reading and analysis. 
May i have some advice on how to do it?
Alberto

comments.body: @aflserna Good question, the best place to ask is on the other platforms; Docs, Discord or Facebook. In GitHub, we track application features and bugs, and no user questions.
